description: Loopback replies: exit 0, Connection up. A documentation-range address (192.0.2.1) never replies: exit 1, Connection down. Bad input (no targets, usrPingCount out of range, a target starting with a dash) is refused with exit 1 and Check could not run. TERM mid-run still prints one fallback result block.

steps.label: Alert: 192.0.2.1 (TEST-NET-1) never replies
outputContains: STATUS=Connection down: 0 of 1 target replied (192.0.2.1 no

steps.label: Alert under usrRequire=all: loopback replies, 192.0.2.1 does not
outputContains: STATUS=Connection degraded: 1 of 2 targets did not reply and all are required

steps.label: Bad input: nothing to check
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: nothing to check

steps.label: Bad input: usrPingCount out of range
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrPingCount must be 1-10 (got '99')

steps.label: Bad input: a target that would reach ping as an option
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrTargets entry '-f' is not an IP address or hostname

steps.label: Killed mid-run: TERM 2 seconds into a 10-ping run still prints exactly one fallback result block and exits 1
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: the monitor stopped unexpectedly (exit 143)
